signature.why: The blink engine the archetype is named for. All ten current field lists run 4 Phelia and 3 Flickerwisp; something has to re-trigger an enters ability every turn or the deck is a pile of value creatures.

The enters abilities worth re-triggering, and 10/10 of the field runs Solitude and Overlord at 4 each. Blinking is only an engine when the bodies pay: Solitude exiles, Overlord returns a card, Witch Enchanter and Emperor of Bones rebuild the board.

The black and white interaction that makes this esper rather than a mono-white blink deck. It is the clause that separates it from orzhov-martyr, which runs the same Phelia, Ephemerate, Flickerwisp, Solitude and Overlord and none of these.
